# MobiVerse

> MobiVerse is a local-first ebook and comic converter for macOS and Windows. It converts DRM-free MOBI, AZW, AZW3, CBZ, CBR, ZIP, and PDF files into polished EPUB 3 books for Apple Books and modern EPUB readers. Files stay on the user's computer.

MobiVerse does not remove DRM. The macOS release bundles the required conversion components, so readers do not need a separate Calibre installation. Converted EPUB files are saved beside the source file by default without overwriting an existing EPUB.

## Current macOS release

MobiVerse 2.4.0 (13), released on 2026-08-04, adds a complete Simplified Chinese interface with an in-app language selector, a responsive interactive 3D shelf, and animated Browse download activity with immediate cancellation. Converting, validating, and newly completed books move to the front of the shelf. Large EPUB cover and metadata extraction is more efficient, and the redundant green completion strip has been removed from 3D covers. The release passed 51 automated tests across 14 suites.

- [MobiVerse 2.4.0 release notes](https://github.com/DemonDevil-Git/MobiVerse/releases/tag/v2.4.0)
- [Download MobiVerse 2.4.0 for macOS](https://github.com/DemonDevil-Git/MobiVerse/releases/download/v2.4.0/MobiVerse-2.4.0.dmg)

## Use cases

- [Convert MOBI to EPUB](https://mobiverse-coral.vercel.app/guides/mobi-to-epub/): Local conversion for DRM-free legacy Kindle files.
- [Convert AZW3 to EPUB](https://mobiverse-coral.vercel.app/guides/azw3-to-epub/): Local migration for readable AZW3 books.
- [Convert CBZ or CBR comics to EPUB](https://mobiverse-coral.vercel.app/guides/cbz-cbr-to-epub/): Fixed-layout EPUB conversion for ordered comic images.
- [Fix comic EPUBs for Apple Books](https://mobiverse-coral.vercel.app/guides/fix-comic-epub-apple-books/): Reduce stretched pages, black pages, margins, and page-size jumps.
- [Offline ebook conversion](https://mobiverse-coral.vercel.app/guides/offline-ebook-converter/): Privacy-focused alternative to upload-based converters.

## Facts and limitations

- Supported inputs: EPUB, MOBI, AZW, AZW3, CBZ, CBR, ZIP, and PDF.
- Primary output: EPUB 3.
- Privacy: conversion, analysis, cover extraction, and preview run locally.
- DRM: MobiVerse does not remove or bypass DRM.
- License: GPL-3.0-or-later.
- Best fit: Apple Books users, manga and comic readers, illustrated ebooks, old Kindle libraries, and users who prefer offline conversion.
